title: CLI sibling revoke finds daemons through the single-file route manifest
goal: After T-CARBONCLOUD-2 moved per-process rendezvous into routes.json, `revoke_on_sibling_bus` still read only the legacy topics/ and prefixes/ files, so `capabilities revoke` contacted no sibling daemon and the test revoke_on_sibling_bus_cancels_daemon_envelope_and_stays_noop_offline failed on main. Expose the bus's own candidate lookup as `plane_bus_ipc::route_candidates` and use it from the CLI, so manifests and legacy files are both honoured by one implementation.

reuse.searched: susi-core plane_bus_ipc: IpcPlaneBus::candidates already resolved manifests plus legacy files; moved its body into a public free function instead of writing a second reader in the CLI.

limitations: No refs/claims or refs/closed record: the remote refuses those pushes from this cloud session.
